serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was sad. She reminded me about my ex and it still hurts just thinking that she’s with someone else. 
You: I thought that the relationship we had would be, you know, like my parents’, to the death.
You: It’s really lonely without her, but because of the way I was treated I never told her about my feelings and I never will...
Blaubleim: So, you shouting at your mom was just a defense mechanism, your way of getting over your loss without losing face.
You: …
